notes: Group covers Texas districts 20-38 only (19 rows). Vote counts come from the Texas Secretary of State results page (electionresults.sos.state.tx.us), which showed the 3 Nov 2026 general with 100% of polling locations reporting; these are unofficial, not yet canvassed. Status 'called' here means the winner leads the unofficial count with all locations reporting; none of these 19 is close enough to look like a recount (closest: TX-27 Cloud +6.5k, TX-32 Yarbrough +8.1k, TX-22 Nehls +10.6k). Background and previous-holder details come from the Texas Tribune story republished by HPPR (https://www.hppr.org/hppr-news/2026-11-04/texas-republicans-gerrymander-backfires-as-democrats-gain-ground-in-u-s-house-delegation), KSAT and Texas Public Radio. Two details rest on search-result summaries rather than full page reads: Julie Johnson's move to the 33rd and runoff with Allred (Texas Tribune / Ballotpedia March 2026 coverage), and Yarbrough being an attorney. Reasons Troy Nehls and Lloyd Doggett left are given only as 'not seeking reelection'/'retiring'. Ballotpedia pages could not be fetched (empty content).
